title: Git repository stats: 4,964 commits, 1.94M insertions (pre-cutoff)
body: The agentic-fleet-hub + silicon-oracle repositories combined contain 4,964 commits as of 2026-06-22: 1,940,009 total insertions, 1,768,480 total deletions. Two committer identities: miguel.an.rodriguez@gmail.com (4,636 commits), miguel@bigbearengineering.com (328 commits). Only 2 commits were tagged.
